Question ID: STAT_U02_L07_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DVD.4

Which measure is most affected by an extreme outlier?

feedback.text: The mean uses every value, so an extreme value can pull it strongly.
The median is resistant because it depends on order, not every distance.
The mode is the most frequent value and may not change because of one outlier.
IQR focuses on the middle half and is less affected by extremes.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U02_L07_GuidedPractice_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DVD.5

A data set is strongly right-skewed. Which center is usually better for a typical value?

feedback.text: The mean is pulled toward the long right tail.
The maximum is an extreme value, not a center.
Range measures spread, not center.
The median is more resistant to skew and outliers.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U02_L07_GuidedPractice_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DVD.6

A roughly normal model has mean 50 and standard deviation 4. About what percent is between 46 and 54?

feedback.text: About 95% is within two standard deviations.
46 to 54 is within one standard deviation of the mean.
About 16% is one tail beyond one standard deviation.
About 99.7% is within three standard deviations.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U02_L07_GuidedPractice_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DVD.4

Which data shape is least appropriate for one normal model?

feedback.text: Two clusters suggest more than one group or process.
This is the general shape expected for a normal model.

answer.text: Roughly balanced data around one center

feedback.text: Balanced data around one center may support a normal model.

answer.text: No strong outliers and one peak

feedback.text: No strong outliers and one peak supports normal model use.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U02_L07_GuidedPractice_Q05

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DVD.5

A normal model has mean 80 and standard deviation 10. About what percent is above 90?

feedback.text: About 34% is between the mean and one standard deviation above.
About 68% is within one standard deviation.
90 is one standard deviation above the mean, so the upper tail is about 16%.
About 84% is below one standard deviation above the mean.
